title: Naturality of the long exact cohomology sequence of short exact sequences of complexes
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], and let $0\to K_1\xrightarrow{f}K_2\xrightarrow{g}K_3\to0$ and $0\to K'_1\xrightarrow{f'}K'_2\xrightarrow{g'}K'_3\to0$ be two sequences of cochain complexes of $\mathcal C$ (indexed by $\mathbf N$ or $\mathbf Z$), each short exact in each degree, with connecting morphisms $\delta^n:H^n(K_3)\to H^{n+1}(K_1)$ and $\delta'^n:H^n(K'_3)\to H^{n+1}(K'_1)$ of their long exact cohomology sequences [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-homology-long-exact]. Let $u_i:K_i\to K'_i$ ($i=1,2,3$) be morphisms of complexes with $f'\circ u_1=u_2\circ f$ and $g'\circ u_2=u_3\circ g$. Then for every $n$, $H^{n+1}(u_1)\circ\delta^n=\delta'^n\circ H^n(u_3)$; together with $H^n(f')H^n(u_1)=H^n(u_2)H^n(f)$ and $H^n(g')H^n(u_2)=H^n(u_3)H^n(g)$ (functoriality of $H^n$), the maps $H^n(u_i)$ form a morphism from the long exact sequence of the first sequence to that of the second.
